description: Digg: search stories live across all seven topics, read the ranked story leaderboard, GitHub feeds (stars/new/activity/recent), and ranking-change history from the terminal. Read-only.

tools.name: feed_raw
tools.description: Fetch the raw HTML of Digg's AI topic page (/ai). Most users should run `top` instead of calling this directly. Returns the RawHTML.

tools.name: feed_story_raw
tools.description: Fetch the raw HTML of one story's page under /ai. Most users should run `story` or `posts` instead of calling this directly. Required: cluster_url_id. Returns the RawHTML.

params.name: cluster_url_id
params.description: Short alphanumeric cluster URL ID (8 chars), e.g. iq7usf9e

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Digg stories live across all seven topics with Digg's own search. Each result carries clusterId, clusterUrlId, title, diggScore, sourceCount, uniqueAuthors, publishedAt, topic and url. Needs no sync.

params.name: limit
params.description: Max number of results (default 20); may exceed one page of 50.

params.name: since
params.description: Only stories published at or after this: a duration back from now (30d, 1w, 12h, 1m) or an ISO date. At most 90 days back.

params.name: until
params.description: Only stories published before this: a duration back from now or an ISO date.

params.name: topic
params.description: Comma-separated Digg topics to search. Default: every topic.

tools.name: github_stars
tools.description: Top repos ranked by starring activity from Digg-tracked accounts. Returns repo_full_name, language, stargazers_count, recent starrer list, breakout_score, novel_score, ai_related_score, and the model's one-sentence classification. Returns the RawHTML; structured records are extracted by the CLI from the embedded RSC payload.

params.name: min-starrers
params.description: Keep only repos starred by >= N distinct Digg-tracked accounts (reads .repo.distinct_starrers; falls back to len(.repo.starrers) when absent). Applied BEFORE --limit. 0 = no filter; must be >= 0.

tools.name: github_new
tools.description: Recently first-seen GitHub repos with the Digg-tracked creator/starrer who first put them on Digg's radar (event_id, event_created_at, repo_full_name, creator). Returns the RawHTML; CLI extracts the per-event records.

tools.name: github_activity
tools.description: Top GitHub contributor leaderboard: per-author rank, contribution count, and distinct repos count over Digg's tracking window. Returns the RawHTML; CLI extracts the leaderboard table rows.

tools.name: github_recent
tools.description: Live GitHub activity feed: per-event entries with the GitHub URL (issue/PR/commit/repo), the user who acted, and a short description of the target. Returns the RawHTML; CLI extracts the per-event tuples.

tools.name: rankings_list
tools.description: Full ranking of people and companies from /tech/x/rankings. Server-paginated; returns the initial-HTML slice. Pass --limit to cap.

params.name: limit
params.description: Max rows to return from the initial-HTML slice (0 = all).

params.name: max-skip-ratio
params.description: Schema-drift tolerance: fraction of entries that may fail to decode before the command exits non-zero. Default 0.10. Range [0, 1].
